title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Hood Mounting Brackets May Detach (11,982 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2014-2018 Sightseer, Itasca Sunova, 2016-2025 Forza, Vista, and Itasca/Winnebago Sunstar, 2015-2025 Adventurer, 2015-2024 Commercial Vehicle, 2015-2028 Itasca Suncruiser, and 2016-2017 Itasca Solei recreational vehicles.  The hood bracket adhesive may have been incorrectly applied which can allow the bracket to detach.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Inverter Wire Unprotected From Battery (6 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 East to West Alta travel trailer vehicles.  The inverter may be incorrectly wired to constant "hot" on the second battery, causing the wire to be unprotected from the battery.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Stove May Detach From The Cabinet (287 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Vibe travel trailer vehicles.  The stove may detach from the cabinet.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Driveshaft Bearings May Fail (23,483 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2016-2025 Metropolitan scooters.  An improper seal between the transmission case and left-side crankcase may allow transmission fluid to leak.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Deactivated Exterior Lighting (5,128 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1T and R1S vehicles.  Software version 2024.39.30 may prevent certain exterior lights from turning on when the Car Costume feature is activated.

title: K.Z., Inc.: Slide-Out Door Actuator May Impact Tire (14 affected)
summary: KZRV, L.P (KZRV) is recalling certain 2025 Sportsmen 303QBSE travel trailers.  The driver's side door slide-out actuator is located too close to the tires, which can cause the actuator to contact the tire.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Insufficient Strength in B-Pillar Structure (3,312 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X1 xDrive28i and X1 M35i vehicles.  The left and right-side B-Pillar reinforcement plates may have been manufactured with insufficient structural strength.

title: International Motors, LLC: Insufficient Lubricant in Front Steer Axle Hub (74 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2024-2025 HX vehicles.  An insufficient amount of lubricant in the front steer drive (FSD) axle hubs may result in damage to the wheel bearings.

title: Aumovio Automotive Systems, Inc: Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster (33,596 affected)
summary: Continental Automotive Systems, Inc. (Continental Automotive) is recalling certain MK C1 EVO brake systems with part number 10-1202.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

title: A2ZEV: Electric Vehicle Charger Adapter May Overheat (8,016 affected)
summary: A2ZEV (A2Z) is recalling certain NACS to CCS1 Original Typhoon/Slider Lock Charger Adapters, with part numbers NC1V10124DC and NC1V10224DC-ILW.  The locking mechanism on the adapter may become damaged and come loose from the NACS connector, which can cause the charger to overheat.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: Improperly Welded Head Pipe May Crack (299 affected)
summary: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A (Kawasaki) is recalling certain Z7 Hybrid ABS and Ninja 7 Hybrid ABS motorcycles.  The connection between the head pipe (steering head) to the frame may have been improperly welded and crack, resulting in a loss of vehicle handling and control.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Seat Belt Not Retracting Properly/FMVSS 209 (1,570 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova) is recalling certain 2010-2020 LFS Artic and 2012-2024 LFS vehicles.  The driver's seat belt may not retract properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Inverter Fault May Cause Loss of Drive Power (2,431 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck vehicles.  A fault in the drive inverter may cause a loss of drive power to the wheels.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster (6 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2020 Polestar 1 vehicles.  The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Short Wiring Harness May Cause Loss of Drive Power (1,539 affected)
summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Air Pure rear wheel drive vehicles.  The rear subframe wiring harness may be too short, straining the electrical connection and causing power loss to the rear drive unit (RDU).

title: PJ Trailers: Air Ride Brake Axle Installed Incorrectly (43 affected)
summary: PJ Trailers is recalling certain 2024-2025 LD trailers.  The air ride suspension brake axles may be installed incorrectly, resulting in reduced braking ability.

title: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC: Incorrect Sidewall Label/FMVSS 139 (150 affected)
summary: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC (Sumitomo) is recalling certain Falken WildPeak AT4W size 275/60R20 115T tires.  The tires may have been produced using the incorrect cord material for one of the plies. The sidewall label incorrectly identifies the generic name of the cord material.  As such, the affected tires do not meet the labeling requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, New pneumatic radial tires for light vehicles.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Ignition May Fail To Detect Locked Exit/FMVSS217 (13 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2023 CT-Series vehicles equipped with a anti-vandal lock on the rear emergency door.  The ignition interlock may allow the vehicle to start when the rear emergency door is locked after the key has been inserted in the ignition.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Ignition May Fail To Detect Locked Exit/FMVSS217 (424 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2024 T-Series school buses equipped with a anti-vandal lock on the rear emergency door.  The ignition interlock may allow the vehicle to start when the rear emergency door is locked after the key has been inserted in the ignition.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Upper Suspension Arm May Detach (16,759 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2014-2016 Range Rover vehicles. The front suspension upper knuckle joint may crack, which can result in suspension arm detachment.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Vehicle Rollaway Due to ABS Malfunction (206,502 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Dodge Durango vehicles.  A malfunction in the antilock-brake system (ABS) module may incorrectly illuminate the brake lights and disable the ABS and electronic stability control (ESC).  In addition, the vehicle operator may be able to start and shift out of Park without the brake pedal being applied.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Air Conditioner May Catch Fire (8 affected)
summary: Jayco Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2024 North Point and Pinnacle travel trailers equipped with certain GE air conditioners.  The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.

title: General Motors, LLC: Incorrect Software in Transmission Control Module (77,824 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vehicles.  Incorrect software in the transmission control module (TCM) may result in harsh shifting, reduced power, unintended deceleration, rear wheel lockup, or cause the vehicle to move in an unintended direction.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Sunshade May Operate Unexpectedly/FMVSS 118 (34,964 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Santa Fe and Santa Fe Hybrid vehicles. The overhead console rear sunshade switch knob may not be fully recessed, which can result in unintentional closing of the sunshade.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window, Partition and Roof Panel Systems."

title: Nikola Corporation: Instrument Panel Failure/FMVSS 101 (72 affected)
summary: Nikola Corporation (Nikola) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Tre BEV vehicles.  A resistor may degrade, causing the instrument panel to fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Control and Displays."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Wiring May Melt and Cause Fire (498 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Catalina and Aurora travel trailers.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The solar panel wiring may be incorrectly wired, causing the wiring to short and overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Bracket May Damage Fuel Line and Cause Leak (65 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Ranger vehicles.  The fuel vapor line bracket may have insufficient clearance to the fuel vapor line, which can result in fuel vapor line damage that can lead to a fuel vapor leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Passenger Air Bag May Deploy Incorrectly/FMVSS 208 (15 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Escape vehicles.  The passenger side instrument panel cover may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the air bag not to deploy as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Forest River, Inc.: Air Conditioner May Catch Fire (2,783 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 Ahara, Entrada, 2022-2025 FR3, Georgetown, 2021-2023 Dynamax Isata, 2021-2025 Encore, Mirada, Pursuit, 2025 Sportscoach, V-Cruise, V-Sport, V-Tour, 2023 Sunseeker, and 2024-2025 V-RV motorhomes, equipped with General Electric air conditioners with a soft start device with part number ICM870-16A-BH5400.  The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Wiring Can Melt and Short (2,898 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Impression fifth wheel travel trailers.  The solar charge line, front LED hitch light, and the pass-thru light may have been wired to the incorrect mini breaker.

title: Winnebago Towable: Solar Panel May Detach While In Transit (1,211 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable is recalling certain 2022 Micro Minnie FLX and Hike travel trailers.  The mounting hardware may come loose, allowing the solar panel to detach.

title: VANCRAFT LLC: Incorrect Seat Belt Hardware May Fail/FMVSS 209 (38 affected)
summary: Vancraft LLC (Vancraft) is recalling certain 2002-2006 Campervan vehicles.  Incorrect seat belt anchor hardware was used on the rear bench seats.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Dashboard Air Bag Warning Label/FMVSS 208 (27,678 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2025 Explorer, Lincoln Aviator, 2020-2024 Escape, Lincoln Corsair, 2018-2024 F-150, Expedition and Lincoln Navigator vehicles.  The air bag warning label may be missing from the dashboard.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirement Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Diamond C Trailer MFG: Axle Frame Bracket Assembly Weld May Fail (1,432 affected)
summary: Diamond C Trailer MFG (Diamond C) is recalling certain 2023-2024 MFG and Pacesetter trailers.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The weld between the axle frame bracket assembly and frame may fail, reducing the trailer's stability while being towed.

title: VANCRAFT LLC: Missing OCCC and Altered Cert Labels/FMVSS110, 567 (224 affected)
summary: VANCRAFT LLC (VanCraft) is recalling certain 2002-2006 Campervan, 2014-2023 SWB Campervan, LWB Campervan, 2023 LWB Campervan Pro, 2023-2024 Rover, Rover XL, and Alltrek vehicles.  The vehicles are missing the Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) label and the altered certification label.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 110, "Tire Selection and Rims" and 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: VANCRAFT LLC: Seat Anchorage System May Fail/FMVSS 207, 209 (255 affected)
summary: VANCRAFT LLC (VanCraft) is recalling certain 2014-2023 SWB, LWB, 2023 LWB Pro, 2023-2024 Rover, Rover XL and Alltrek campervans.  The reinforcement hardware, mounting hardware, and seat belt anchor bolts in the rear bench seating system may fail under load.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 207, "Seating Systems" and 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Incorrectly Assembled Right-Side Curtain Air Bag (2 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 xDrive vehicles.  The gas generator in the right-side head curtain air bag may have been assembled incorrectly.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Driver's Seat Frame Improperly Tightened/FMVSS 207 (121 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Honda Accord, Accord Hybrid, Civic Sedan, Civic Hatchback, Pilot, and 2024 HR-V, Acura Integra and Acura Integra Type S vehicles.  The driver's seat cushion frame may not have been tightened properly, which can result in an unsecured seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Tire Size on Labels/FMVSS 110 (204 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023 Alfa Romeo Stelvio vehicles that were previously remedied under NHTSA recall number 24V-512.  The tire size information on the tire placard is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Brake Pedal Failure (3 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR Brake Pedal Assemblies with part number 68607178AA.  The brake pedal may collapse and cause a loss of brake function.

title: General Motors, LLC: Missing Rear Vision Camera Video Display/FMVSS 111 (582 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Express Commercial Cutaway and GMC Savana Commercial Cutaway vehicles.  These vehicles may be missing the required rear vision camera video display because an incorrect inside rearview mirror was installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: Altered Fuel Tank May Leak Fuel (4 affected)
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2022 FTR 1200 R Carbon, FTR 1200, FTR 1200 S and FTR 1200 Rally motorcycles.  These motorcycles may have been assembled with an altered fuel tank containing holes that can leak fuel.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Oil Filter May Unscrew Due to Engine Vibration (4,803 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain BMW Dealer Service Part Oil Filters designed to fit S1000RR, M1000RR/R/XR, HP4 (Race) motorcycles, and with part number 11427721779-04.  The vibration frequencies from certain high-revving four-cylinder motorcycle engines can cause the oil filter to unscrew during riding.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Cracked LP Gas Quick Disconnect Fitting Can Leak (30,435 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2022 Imagine, Reflection, Momentum, Solitude, and Transcend travel trailers.  The quick disconnect fittings in the LP gas system may be cracked, causing a gas leak.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improperly Tightened Rear Axle Differential Bolts (3 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 GLC 300 4MATIC, and S 580 4MATIC vehicles.  The bolts that secure the rear axle differential to the rear axle carrier may come loose, which can result in a separation of the drive shaft from the rear axle differential.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Battery Warming Pad Can Short (48 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2025 Lineage 25FW motorhomes.  The battery warming pad was installed incorrectly, which can damage internal wiring and cause an electrical short.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Fuel Pump May Fail (40,481 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2007, 2009-2017 CBR600RR, 2008-2017, 2021 CBR1000RR, and 2010, 2012-2013 VFR1200 motorcycles.  The fuel pump impellers may have been improperly molded, which can cause them to deform and result in fuel pump failure.

title: Fisker Group Inc: Transmission Error Can Allow Vehicle Roll Away (7,745 affected)
summary: Fisker Group Inc (Fisker) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ocean vehicles.  The transmission may not shift into the selected gear, allowing the vehicle to roll away while in Drive or Reverse.

title: Trail King Industries, Inc.: Suspension May Separate From Weak Subframe Beam (396 affected)
summary: Trail King Industries, Inc. (Trail King) is recalling certain 2020-2024 TKHT Hydraulic Tail trailers.  The suspension assembly could flex the subframe beam, causing the beam to fatigue and crack.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Loss of Drive Power from Damaged Charging Unit (62,872 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2022-2024 EV6 vehicles.  The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Drive Power from Damaged Charging Unit (145,642 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2022-2024 IONIQ 5, 2023-2025 IONIQ 6, Genesis GV60, Genesis GV70 "Electrified," and Genesis G80 "Electrified" vehicles.  The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Limitless Van: Improperly Welded Tire Mount May Fall Into Roadway (28 affected)
summary: Limitless Van is recalling certain rear tire mounts.  An improper weld may fail, allowing the rear tire mount to detach from the vehicle.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Incorrect Vehicle Speed Displayed/ FMVSS 101 (7,198 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  A software error in the instrument panel cluster may cause the speedometer to display the incorrect vehicle speed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Displays and Controls."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Improperly Tightened Second-Row Seat Bolts (11 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2025 EX90 vehicles.  The bolts for the second-row free-standing seat may not be tightened properly.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Air Bags May Not Deploy as Intended (3 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 530i and 540i xDrive vehicles.  The air bag control unit may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can result in the air bags not deploying as intended.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Inoperative Trailer Lighting/FMVSS 108 (34 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024 Jeep Wrangler vehicles.  The incorrect dash wiring harness was installed, which can result in inoperative trailer lighting.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Defective Coolant Sensor May Shut Down Engine (758 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2023 LFS Artic and 2022-2024 LFS buses.  The coolant sensor could send a false signal, causing the engine to shut down.

title: Britax Child Safety, Inc.: Incorrect Maximum Weight on Labels/ FMVSS 213 (1,286 affected)
summary: Britax Child Safety, Inc. (Britax) is recalling certain One4Life Slim ClickTight All-in-One car seats with model numbers E1D197A, E1D197B, E1D197F, and E1D197G.  The labels and user guide incorrectly state the maximum rear-facing lower anchor weight.  As such, these child seats fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Glass Sunroof Panel May Detach (33,456 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2001-2011 C-Class, CLK, E-Class, and CLS vehicles.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models and model years.  The glass sunroof panel may not be properly secured and can detach.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (385 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023 ID.4 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse or when the park function is manually activated.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Oliver Travel Trailers, INC.: Loose Water Heater Burner Assembly May Start Fire (784 affected)
summary: Oliver Travel Trailers, INC. (OTT) is recalling certain 2016-2024 Elite I and Elite II travel trailers equipped with a Truma Aqua Go Water Heater with Burner Assembly, part number 77000-90400.  The water heater burner bracket assembly may become loose, causing wiring damage and the flame to be misdirected.

title: Lippert: Towed Vehicle May Detach From Pin Box (675 affected)
summary: Lippert is recalling certain Curt Helux Pin Boxes, part numbers 2024032921, 2024032924, 2024032925 and 2024113005; installed in Lippert 5W Chassis.  The pin box fasteners may have been improperly tightened.

title: Agility Fuel Solutions: CNG Manual Cylinder Valve May Crack And Leak (1,436 affected)
summary: Agility Fuel Solutions (Agility) is recalling certain Roof-Mounted, Tailgate-Mounted, and Front-of-Body Mounted CNG Fuel Systems.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of part numbers.  The manual cylinder valves may develop stress corrosion cracks in the bottom plugged port, causing a leak.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Vehicle Roll Away from Improperly Routed Wiring (42,465 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Tucson and Santa Cruz vehicles.  The console extension wiring assembly may be routed improperly, allowing the transmission to be shifted out of Park without applying the brake pedal.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Lower Boom May Fail (158 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 1995-1996 AM and AN aerial devices.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of models.  The hydraulic cylinder head gland may have been improperly manufactured, which can result in it detaching from the barrel of the cylinder while under load, leaving the lower boom unsupported.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Rearview Image May Not Display/ FMVSS 111 (226,118 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Santa Fe, Santa Fe HEV, Elantra, Elantra HEV and 2022 Elantra N and Santa Fe PHEV vehicles.  Due to a damaged printed circuit board, the rearview camera image may fail to display.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Steering Intermediate Shaft May Fracture (8,057 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Corolla and Corolla Hybrid vehicles.  Due to cracks developed during the manufacturing process, the steering intermediate shaft assembly may fracture and possibly result in the shaft detaching from the steering column.

title: International Motors, LLC: Delayed Service Brake Release/FMVSS 121 (57 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2022-2025 HX vehicles.  The service brake may take longer than expected to release.  As such, these vehicles may fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Engine Stall from Software Error (4,205 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2022 and 2024-2025 CRF1100 Africa Twin motorcycles.  A software error in the fuel injection electronic control unit (FI-ECU) may cause an engine stall or a loss of power when the Wheelie Control feature is activated.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Front Seat Back Recliners Improperly Welded (27 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024 Model Y vehicles.  The weld attaching the seat recliner mechanism to the front seat backs may fail.

title: Brinkley RV: Towed Vehicle May Detach from Pin Box (466 affected)
summary: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Model Z Fifth Wheel trailers equipped with Curt Helux Pin Boxes.  The pin box fasteners may have been improperly tightened.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Fresh Water Tank May Detach (357 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Viking and Clipper travel trailers.  The fresh water holding tank support bracket may be the incorrect gauge and may break.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Undersized Axles and Tires Installed/FMVSS 120 (2 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Cedar Creek CRT40RDE Fifth Wheel trailers.  Undersized axles and tires may have been installed, which can lead to a tire detaching.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.: Rear Leaf Spring May Break (224 affected)
summary: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (Mitsubishi Fuso) is recalling certain 2016-2020 FEC52, FEC72, and FEC92 vehicles.  The rear leaf spring may break.

title: Braun Corporation: Missing Seat Limiter/FMVSS 208 (44 affected)
summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2024 Chrysler Pacifica and Voyager vehicles.  The seat limiter may not have been installed, allowing the seat to move too far forward.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Headlights are Too Bright/FMVSS 108 (2,941 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Macan Electric vehicles.  The headlights may be too bright and exceed the maximum light output, which may adversely affect the vision of drivers.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Missing Spare Tire Wheel Bolts (632 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ekko motorhomes.  The wheel bolts for the spare tire may be missing

title: Pagani S.p.A: Passenger Air Bag May Deploy Incorrectly (8 affected)
summary: Pagani S.p.A (Pagani) is recalling certain 2024 Utopia vehicles.  The passenger side dashboard panel may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the air bag not to deploy as intended.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Rearview Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (1,710 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Grecale and 2024 GranTurismo vehicles.  The Central Vision Park Assist Module (CVPAM) software may prevent the rearview image from displaying when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Volvo Bus Corporation: Emergency Exit Label May Detach/FMVSS 217 (5 affected)
summary: Volvo Bus Corporation (Volvo Bus) is recalling certain 2025 Volvo 9700 buses.  The emergency exit labels that provide exit identification and operating instructions may not be secured properly, allowing the labels to detach.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: General Motors, LLC: Tailgate May Open While Driving (131,231 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Silverado HD 2500, 3500, and GMC Sierra HD 2500, 3500 vehicles equipped with power-unlatching tailgates.  The tailgate's electronic gate-release switch may short circuit due to water intrusion, which can result in the tailgate inadvertently unlatching while the vehicle is in Park.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Fuel Leak from Fuel Filler Pipe Separation (205,760 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Passport and 2023-2025 Pilot vehicles.  The fuel filler neck tube and fuel filler pipe may separate, allowing fuel to leak.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of ABS/Traction Control from Module Failure (317,630 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2017-2018 Ram 2500 Pickup, Ram 3500 Pickup, 3500 Cab Chassis, 4500 and 5500 Cab Chassis vehicles.  The hydraulic control unit (HCU) may fail, which can cause the anti-lock brake (ABS), electronic stability control (ESC), and traction control systems to fail.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of ABS/Traction Control from Module Failure (84,923 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain MOPAR Brake Hydraulic Control Units (HCU) with part numbers 68195569AA and 68143491AA.  When installed on a vehicle, the hydraulic control unit (HCU) may fail, which can cause the anti-lock brake (ABS), electronic stability control (ESC), and traction control systems to fail.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Taillights May Overheat and Fail/FMVSS 108 (17 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Concord, Entourage, Freelander, and Leprechaun motorhomes.  The taillights may overheat and fail to illuminate.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Front Seat Side Air Bags May Not Deploy/FMVSS 214 (14 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and 2021-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  An improperly secured connector for the front seat side air bags (SAB) may prevent the air bags from deploying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 214, "Side Impact Protection."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High-Voltage Battery May Overheat and Cause Fire (4,616 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Audi Q5 PHEV and 2022 Audi A7 PHEV vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.

title: Nuna Baby Essentials, Inc.: Front Harness Adjuster on Child Seat May Fail (608,786 affected)
summary: Nuna Baby Essentials, Inc. (Nuna) is recalling certain Rava child seats with a plastic harness adjuster button, manufactured between July 16, 2016 and October 25, 2023.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of model numbers.  Debris may enter the front harness adjuster and cause the mechanism to fail, resulting in a loose harness.

title: Keystone RV Company: Towed Vehicle May Detach From Pin Box (303 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2025 Arcadia and Cougar trailers equipped with Curt Helux Pin Boxes.  The pin box fasteners may have been improperly tightened.

title: McLaren Automotive Incorporated: Rear Window May Detach (163 affected)
summary: McLaren Automotive Incorporated (McClaren) is recalling certain 2021 765LT Coupe vehicles.  The rear cabin window may have insufficient adhesive bonding, which can allow the window to detach from the support frame.

title: Kuntry Kustom RV, LLC: Air Conditioner May Catch Fire (347 affected)
summary: Kuntry Kustom RV, LLC (Kuntry Kustom) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Rich Specialty Sanitation and Office trailers, equipped with certain GE air conditioners. The air conditioner soft start device may fail and overheat.
